Smack Technologies is building the first frontier AI lab for national security — developing specialized large-scale AI models trained on defense data to achieve what the company calls "Decision Dominance" on the battlefield. Their two flagship models, codenamed Omega and Alpha, are purpose-built for military decision-making where commercial AI fundamentally fails: classified data environments, lethal stakes, and latency requirements that commercial LLMs were never designed to meet. Founded in 2024 by two MARSOC veterans — Andy Markoff (CEO) and Clint Alanis (COO) — the company is already under contract with the Air Force, Marine Corps, and Navy, with two of those three contracts moving from prototype to production.

Starfish Space builds autonomous satellite-servicing spacecraft — their vehicle, Otter, rendezvouses and docks with other objects in orbit to reposition satellites, extend their operational life, or safely deorbit them. The company already holds executed defense and commercial contracts; this round funds mission execution and production scale-up. Founded by ex-Blue Origin engineers; based in Kent, WA.
